svg.text: learn-opensible — AWS on LocalStack · GitOps · OpenTelemetry
Four flows: control · CI/CD · request · telemetry
2 · EMULATED AWS — LocalStack Pro, gateway :4566, routes on the Host header
LocalStack EKS is a real 3-node k3d cluster, not an emulation →
git is the source of truth, deletes included
They never learn which backend exists.
4 · CI/CD — CI never touches the cluster
CodeBuild holds ECR and git-write permissions only — no kubeconfig, no kubectl in the buildspec.
The cluster pulls from git. Rollback is git revert, not a pipeline re-run.
Images are tagged by commit, so every service rolls on every build — see README §3.4.
NodePort 30080 · the Host header picks the ALB — every UI has its own hostname, so all of them serve at /
SVG — edit it in a text editor; git diff shows every changed line
gitops/bootstrap/appset.yaml is the ONLY file playbook 3 applies by hand
